transcript: Mard, 45 saal. Ek hafte se khansi. Pila balgham ho raha. Bukhar saans nahi. Fulta sinegi dain. Terafax baad aadhi hai. Augmentin 625 din mein do baar. 5 din khansi raat do chamach din mein teen baar. Cigarette band karni hai. Cbc test check karwa lein.

medications.name: Augmentin
medications.instructions: take 2 teaspoons of cough syrup 3 times daily
